name: Hoi An summer beach festival
nameVi: Hội An - Cảm xúc mùa hè
summary: In 2024 the beach festival ran from 15 June to 21 July at Cửa Đại, Tân Thành, An Bàng, and Cù Lao Chàm. The opening days, 14 to 16 June, were at Cửa Đại, with dance, music, food, a DJ, fire performance, beach games, kites, and an OCOP stall row. In July, An Bàng held Mùa hè bất tận: sea-themed work in lanterns and recycled wood, coastal food, beach music, and sport. The heritage centre set that An Bàng program at 16:00 on 12 July 2024. The next dates and any fee are check on arrival.
when: 15 June to 21 July 2024. The next dates are check on arrival.
